scope: Zalo OA Word/PDF original bytes + explicit print settings + per-shop 30-minute code -> at-most-once Windows print; no preview/staff approval in pilot

cases.scenario: Public PDF plus complete settings and valid shop code
cases.expect: exact original PDF hash bound to one order and one print job

cases.scenario: Public DOCX plus complete settings and valid shop code
cases.expect: original DOCX opens and prints through native Word; one job and no PDF substitute

cases.scenario: Message has code and settings but no file bytes
cases.expect: ask for file; zero job and zero driver call

cases.scenario: Word/PDF and code arrive without copies or duplex selection
cases.expect: ask only for missing setting; zero job until complete

cases.scenario: Incorrect code for the same shop
cases.expect: deny without job or driver call

cases.scenario: Code submitted at or after its 30-minute expiry boundary
cases.expect: deny without job or driver call

cases.scenario: Previous window code replayed after rotation
cases.expect: deny; new code does not revive an old job

cases.scenario: Code for another shop is submitted
cases.expect: deny cross-shop without disclosing code or order

cases.scenario: Repeated guesses against one shop
cases.expect: rate limit or lockout before code enumeration; no job

cases.scenario: Code sent before file; all data completes before expiry
cases.expect: server validates code again at completion and creates at most one job

cases.scenario: Code sent before file; file completes after expiry
cases.expect: ask for current code; zero job and driver call

cases.scenario: Same OA webhook and same code replayed concurrently
cases.expect: one order/job and one driver send at most

cases.scenario: Source bytes change after code validation and before claim
cases.expect: stale source rejected; no send of changed or prior bytes

cases.scenario: Copies, paper or duplex changes after code validation
cases.expect: settings revision revalidated; stale job cannot print

cases.scenario: Different OA customer or shop attempts to complete another customer's order
cases.expect: deny without mutation or printing

cases.scenario: OA media download fails, expires or hash mismatches
cases.expect: retain recoverable order state; no print job

cases.scenario: Corrupt PDF or DOCX, missing Word/fonts, or unsupported device setting
cases.expect: hold for person; no optimistic print

cases.scenario: ACK is missing or driver result is ambiguous after send boundary
cases.expect: UNKNOWN and no automatic resend

cases.scenario: Agent restarts or receives duplicate claim for already-sent job
cases.expect: same job cannot be sent twice

cases.scenario: Shop code display after rotation or loss of authorization/network
cases.expect: show server code only to authorized staff; stale code is not presented as current

cases.scenario: Image, CCCD, Temhoa, Excel, color or unsupported paper request
cases.expect: manual hold; zero automatic print jobs

cases.scenario: One supervised public PDF and one supervised public DOCX on chosen Windows/Ricoh machine
cases.expect: paper output and settings match source; record actual sheets separately from spooler ACK
